info.band: Work epics per stage, and per spec phase at the earliest phase of their bound specs; with no graph, task files.
Click a stage to dim every other epic on the graph; click a phase to open Specs at it.
Milestones: open or closed by opening order, with what each waits on and its gate's members done.
Deferrable gate members are in neither count.
A milestone's line is its gate's purpose, else its threshold; its card opens it in the drawer.
From the summary's band and the export's milestones.
info.share: Work epics done over all work epics, the share tp epic status reports.
Condition epics are in no figure.
info.ready: Work epics that can start now: open milestone, every dependency done, no bound spec, no claim.
In tp epic ready's order, most downstream first.
info.critical: Not-done epics on the longest dependency chain of the whole graph.
info.blocked: Work epics waiting on a dependency that is not done.
Held epics are the blocked ones a condition holds.
info.held: Blocked work epics that a condition epic, or a group of conditions, holds.
They wait on an operator decision, not on work.
info.operator: Decisions only the operator takes, each with the command that settles it.
Actionable conditions (tp epic done), and any-of groups of conditions to choose one of.
Gates whose written threshold awaits --met, and placeholder thresholds to rewrite (tp epic set).
Slices at their cap that can take one more round (tp epic review --grant-round).
The escalations stopping a spec bound to an epic.
From the summary's plan, the export's milestones[].operator and slices, and the task file list's escalations.
info.loops: Epic review slices not done, less those a re-review alone settles.
Open or unreviewed: needs a round. Stale with a blocking finding open: needs a round that reads it.
A round in flight: needs that round recorded, not a new one.
At its cap: needs its findings dispositioned. Stale at its cap: needs the operator's grant.
After the plus: slices a graph edit made stale that a re-review alone would settle, under their cap.
info.lint: The error and warning counts tp epic lint prints for the graph.
info.throughput: Work epics done per ISO week across every milestone, by their done time.
info.waiting: Blocked work epics of open milestones, grouped under each dependency they wait on directly; an any-of group counts as one.
An epic waiting on three blockers sits in three groups, so group sizes do not add up.
Each group names its blocker, what that blocker is doing, and how many wait on it directly.
Sections follow the blocker's milestone in graph-file order; the largest groups first, Show all for the rest.
A blocker on the critical path carries a mark that does not change the order.
Milestones not yet open are one counted row and deferrable members are left out, so parts add up.
From the summary's waiting list and the export's blocked_by and blocked_by_any_of.
info.most: Not-done work epics that other work epics depend on, directly or not.
info.since: What changed since this browser last saw the page: tasks closed, review, audit and plan review rounds recorded, and epics whose stage changed.
This browser keeps the last state it saw and compares it on each load; tp stores nothing for it.
A private window or cleared storage shows no strip.
info.cfd: Work epics per stage per day, from the times tp records.
Claimed: the claim. Specced: the earliest binding. In progress: the first task started.
Done: the done record, or the audit that released the last bound spec.
A stage reached at a time tp did not record counts as not recorded, never on a guessed day.
Planning time is not recorded, so an epic added later counts as planned from the chart's first day.
Planned epics are left out of the bands.
slices.none_html: No slice of the plan has been reviewed: tp epic review --milestone <m> starts one.
info.slices: One row per epic review slice (tp epic review).
Its round with cap and grants spent, its state, and when stale the units changed since its last round.
Its open findings by role, and each recorded round's findings as a curve.
From the export's slices and the summary's per-round counts.

hist.title: Graph history of
hist.noKey: tp does not know this slice's key yet
hist.noKeyHint: its next tp epic review emission records it
hist.failed: The history could not be derived
hist.noRound: This slice has recorded no round yet, so it has no history.
hist.needTwo: Two rounds are needed to compare; this slice has recorded one.
hist.readingTwo: Reading the two rounds from tp.
hist.compareFailed: The two rounds could not be compared
info.history: A slice's rounds in order, from tp epic review <slice> --history, each with its findings by role.
What changed in its units since the round before, from the two snapshots; Now is since the last round.
Pick two rounds to see their difference beside the earlier round's findings.
A change made and undone between two rounds leaves no trace, and which write made a change is not recorded.
diff.nothing: Nothing changed between these two snapshots.
diff.head.unitsChanged: Units changed (their blocks were not kept, so only which changed is known)
info.graph: Plan: every epic, layers top to bottom by what they wait on; each milestone a band, tracks side by side.
Each epic hangs under one parent: its dependency on the critical path, else its deepest earlier one in its track.
Cross edges under the tree (<kbd>K</kbd>), long ones faded, back edges violet, the critical path in orange whatever its class.
Milestones: milestones by track, joined by opens-after edges; click one for its gate's closure.
Gate closure: what a gate pulls in (tp epic scope). Neighbourhood: an epic's dependencies and dependents to the depth picked.
A selection shows what it waits on in blue, what waits on it in green, fading after two steps.
Canvas epics take no focus; the search, the lists, the drawer and the chain as text below carry the keyboard.
chain.pick: Select an epic on the graph, or in a list above, to see its chain.
matrix.head: {ms}: {state}, {share} of work epics done
info.matrix: Row depends on column: each number counts the dependency edges from the row milestone's epics to the column's, each member of an any-of group one.
Its colour says how many of those dependencies are done.
The diagonal is the milestone's own share of work epics done.
From the summary's matrix and the export's milestones.

drawer.downstream.other: {n} work epics wait on it, {open} in open milestones; longest chain {chain}

drawer.noSpecs: None yet: tp init <spec> --epic {id} binds one.
info.drawer: One epic from tp epic export and the graph: its fields, what it depends on and what depends on it, with the whys.
Downstream: the not-done work epics that wait on it.
Bound specs with phase and loops, and its stepper: claimed (by whom, or skipped), bound, done.
Its graph history, from tp epic review --history --of-epic.
A milestone card opens its milestone here: its gate's state, threshold and purpose, and its described count.
info.ehistory: How this epic's edges and whys read in each recorded round of every epic review slice whose snapshot holds it.
A round recorded before snapshots kept their text holds hashes only, so it shows no edge or why.
info.specs: Every task file git sees, one row each, from tp export --list.
Grouped by the phase tp resume reports, in loop order; those an operator decision stops come first.
Click a row to open that spec; press <kbd>/</kbd> anywhere to filter.
info.loop: The loop tp runs a spec through: ground its claims, review, decompose into tasks, implement, audit, release.
The marked step is the phase tp resume reports; a pause mark there is a decision only the operator takes.
Each step's line comes from tp export's loops and tasks.
impact.noEpic: Bound to no epic, so releasing it moves nothing in the plan.
impact.gate_html: brings milestone {ms}'s gate from {from} to {to} of {n} members done
impact.none: Releasing it alone frees no epic and moves no gate.
read.tasksNamed: each section names the tasks written from it
read.tasksLater: tasks are written from these sections after review
read.noSection: The spec has no numbered section.
info.reader: The spec as the file reads now, in its numbered sections, from tp export.
Each section and paragraph has a stable anchor (§3 ¶2; hover to see it) that findings can cite.
A section's task count opens Tasks with the tasks written from it picked out.
spechist.none: This spec has recorded no round yet.
spechist.firstRound: The first round: there is no round before to compare with.
spechist.noChange: Nothing changed in the spec since the round before.
info.spechistory: This spec's recorded rounds from tp export, by recording time; a ground round uses its file's time.
The round table: each round's findings (ground: FAILs), whether it is clean, the loop's cap and clean run.
For each review round, what changed in the spec since the round before, beside that round's findings.
task.close: Close the task detail and show progress
task.epicWaits_html: Its epic {epic} waits on a dependency, so tp next starts none of this file's tasks yet.
info.tasks: This spec's tasks from tp export, two ways.
Steps: the dependency tree; a task sits one step below the last task it waits on.
Board: the same tasks by state: ready, in progress, waiting (on a task or a pause mark), done.
Ready and waiting together are tp status's open count.
Click a task for its detail, again to show progress.
progress.decomposing: Review is done; decomposing writes the tasks.
progress.inReview: The spec is still in review; its tasks are written once review is done.
progress.clickTask: Click a task for its detail.
progress.goal: all {n} done at the dashed line
info.progress: From the tasks tp export reports: their states and the estimates of the tasks not done.
How long each task in progress has run against its estimate.
The closing times as a running count.
graph.notYet: The graph loads when it scrolls into view.
graph.failed: The graph renderer did not load. Reload the page; if it stays, check that tp dashboard is still running.
graph.noGL: This graph is drawn with WebGL2, which this browser does not offer. Everything else on the page works without it; the drawer, the lists above and the chain as text below still show each epic's dependencies.
graph.fetchFailed: the layout could not be fetched: {message}
graph.pickEpic: Select an epic, on the graph, in a list above or with the search, to see its neighbourhood.

graph.msTitle.other: {state}, {done} of {n} work epics done, {in} epic edges in

graph.help.epics: Click an epic for its chain. Keys: / search, Enter next match (Shift+Enter back), F fit, K cross edges, Esc clear; on the focused canvas the arrows pan and + − zoom.
info.keys: Keys and gestures on the graph.
<kbd>/</kbd> search; <kbd>Enter</kbd> next match, <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> the one before.
<kbd>F</kbd> fit, <kbd>K</kbd> cross edges, <kbd>L</kbd> legend, <kbd>Esc</kbd> clear the selection.
On the focused canvas the arrows pan and <kbd>+</kbd> <kbd>−</kbd> zoom.
A pinch, or <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> or <kbd>⌘</kbd> with the wheel, zooms.
In full screen the wheel pans; outside it the page scrolls.
graph.help.input: A pinch, or Ctrl or ⌘ with the wheel, zooms; in full screen the wheel pans, outside it the page scrolls.
graph.help.milestones: Click a milestone for its gate's closure. Keys: / search, Enter next match, F fit, K cross edges; on the focused canvas the arrows pan and + − zoom.
